parameters.query:
-- Get-or-create conversation for this lead (no ON CONFLICT: conversations.lead_phone has no unique constraint).
WITH existing AS (
  SELECT conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode
  FROM conversations
  WHERE lead_phone = $1
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3, 'pending_assignment'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode
)
SELECT conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode FROM existing;

-- Log the inbound message now that we have a conversation_id.
-- Update the message row that WF1 already inserted (which had conversation_id=NULL).
UPDATE messages
SET conversation_id = $1::uuid, sender_type = 'lead'
WHERE msg_external_id = $2
RETURNING message_id;

-- Try to find a matching property from the listings table.
-- Search by property ID first, then by text similarity.
SELECT id, listing_hash, title, price, price_numeric, currency,
       location, property_type, operation_type, bedrooms, bathrooms,
       area_m2, description, url, image_url
FROM listings
WHERE is_active = true
  AND (
    listing_hash = $1
    OR title ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
    OR location ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
    OR url ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
  )
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Cache the property for WF4 to use later.
INSERT INTO properties_cache (property_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE
  SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, fetched_at = NOW();
